population.kidComparison: About 55 million people live here, right across the Earth's Equator.

geography.climate: Warm and tropical along the Indian Ocean coast, and cooler with sunny days and crisp nights in the central highlands.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Black, red, and green horizontal stripes separated by thin white lines, with a traditional Maasai shield and crossed spears in the center.

anthem.title: Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu
anthem.summary: Swahili for 'O God of All Creation,' a prayer for peace, unity, and plenty.

exploration.didYouKnow: Nairobi is the only capital city in the world with a full wildlife national park right next to its skyscrapers!

regionalTraits: Carries compact binoculars around their neck at all times
Can sprint like a marathon runner when spotted
Always drinks hot spiced chai tea
